name: JW Marriott Venice Resort & Spa
insider_take: Venice's only resort-style retreat sits on its own private island, Isola delle Rose, offering an exclusive escape from the bustling crowds while keeping St. Mark's Square just a 20-minute boat ride away.
whats_special: This luxurious oasis occupies a transformed 16th-century monastery on a secluded 16-acre island in the Venetian Lagoon. The resort features its own private marina, organic rooftop garden where herbs for the restaurants are grown, and panoramic views of Venice's iconic skyline. As part of Marriott's ultra-premium Luminous collection, it offers unparalleled service with a dedicated island concierge team.
pro_tip: Book the complimentary 24-hour shuttle boat service in advance - it runs every 30 minutes to St. Mark's Square and allows you to skip the crowded water taxis while enjoying VIP transport with stunning lagoon views.
dont_miss: The world-class Sapore Spa with treatments using local Venetian ingredients, sunset aperitivo on the Sagra Rooftop Terrace overlooking the Doge's Palace, and a morning walk through the resort's olive groves and lavender gardens - a surprisingly tranquil experience you won't find anywhere else in Venice.
pros: Prime location on private island near St. Mark's Square with exclusive water taxi access
Luxurious spa facilities and wellness amenities in serene lagoon setting
Exceptional fine dining restaurants with panoramic Venice views
Elegant rooms and suites with modern amenities and Italian design elements
cons: Island location requires water transportation for all city access
Premium pricing reflecting luxury positioning and Venice location
